column3: MT 65:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “to you silence is praise” is rendered “Praise is awaiting You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you atone for them” is rendered “You will provide atonement for them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “girded with might” is rendered “clothed with power.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the inhabitants of the ends” is rendered “who dwell in the farthest parts.”
Close to the Hebrew; וַתְּשֹׁקְקֶהָ (“make it overflow”) is rendered “water it.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reverses “furrows” and “ridges” in the first two lines.
Close to the Hebrew; “the year of your goodness” is rendered “the year with Your goodness,” and “fatness” “abundance.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the hills gird themselves with rejoicing” is rendered “the little hills rejoice on every side.”
